schoolName: University of Hargeisa College of Medicine and Health Sciences
reviewNotes: HOLD - The current University of Hargeisa site lists Medicine and Surgery (MBBS); its undergraduate admissions page identifies Faculty of Medicine and Surgery, and the Somaliland National Health Professions Commission lists the university's Medicine programme as accredited. The Somaliland Ministry notes limited sector data and insufficient historical regulation. Current fees, full programme structure, clinical-placement terms, international admissions/support and target-market licensing evidence were not assembled, so publication is not justified.
